# AI Portals — AI Web Books for Malaysian Legal Professionals

AI Portals (by Shahrul Mizan) is Malaysia's first AI-enhanced legal reference platform.
It offers seven interactive AI-powered web books designed for Malaysian lawyers, corporate
secretaries, conveyancers, and legal practitioners.

## What this site is

A marketing and subscription portal for AI Web Books — subscription-based AI-powered
legal reference tools covering Malaysian law. Each book is a standalone web application
that combines curated primary sources with AI search and summarisation.

## Target audience

Malaysian legal professionals:
- Litigators (civil and Syariah)
- Corporate secretaries
- Conveyancers
- Criminal law practitioners
- Construction law / CCB practitioners

## Available AI Web Books

1. MyLitAI (https://mylitai.life) — Civil Litigation
2. MySyalitAI (https://mysyalitai.life) — Syariah Litigation
3. MyCorpAI (https://mycorpai.life) — Corporate Secretary
4. MyConveyAI (https://myconveyai.life) — Conveyancing
5. MyCrimAI (https://mycrimai.replit.app) — Criminal Law
6. MyCCBLitAI (https://my-ccb-lit-ai.replit.app) — Construction Law (CCB)

## Preferred canonical homepage

https://aiportals.my/

## Subscription model

Access is sold as individual-app subscriptions or firm/corporate/education bundles
through a cohort-based (kohort) model with limited slots per intake. Payment is via
bank transfer or online banking in Malaysian Ringgit (MYR).

## Do not index

/admin — internal admin dashboard, not public content
